en: He... hello, $n. Sorry, I'm recovering from my wounds.$B$BThose Scarlet Crusaders are tougher than I had given them credit for. They almost did me in.$B$BYou should be careful too. I'd hate to see them get the jump on you.

Alas, it always seems like it does.  I - as did the rest of the Cenarion Circle - had assumed that Milli's creation was destroyed during the War of the Ancients.  This, as I have come to learn, is far from correct.$B$BThe Fruit of Fertility survived... though now it is known as the Felvine.  It is being corrupted by the demonic lord of that section of Eldre'Thalas, Alzzin the Wildshaper.

Yep. You never heard of Ironfoe? The legendary orc slaying hammer? Yep, yep, that was ol' Windsor's hammer. He told me that Franclorn Forgewright himself made that hammer for his great, great, grand pappy. THE Franclorn Forgewright: The Dark Iron responsible for stonewrought archimetenc... building stuff. He also said the hammer had a twin that Franclorn kept for himself. Think he called it Ironfel or something.
*cough* who goes there? *cough*
As you wish, Eitrigg.
The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.
You have my deepest gratitude, $N. I thank you.
Success!  Huzzah!  The power source restored the necklace!
Ok, $n. Follow me to the cave where I'll attempt to harness the power of the rune stone into these goggles.
Hahah!  That was funny!  Funny wooden human!
Cho'Rush die! NOW YOU DIE!
Alright, I'll sign writs now. Bring 'em to the front, maggots.
Many thanks, $n.  These horns are going to make me a fortune!
Frigate Ho! 'Tis an Orc vessel no doubt! Fire!

It is Vesprystus that you seek.  He watches over the hippogryphs that come and go from the base of Teldrassil.  You will find him through the portal in western Darnassus that will take you to Rut'theran Village.
Very well, $n.
Us know where they are!  Skull building in Magic Quarter on outer ring of city.
No, Vaelan, I do not.
A gnome? How pathetic. Face me, demon!
I think Plugger filled one of his kegs too much.  It looks like it's about to blow!
Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate, $n.
Where's the rest of the guys?
You be dead soon!
Keep it up, $n, and I'll beat some manners into you.
Bah, it isn't here.  Where did I have that blasted thing at last?
Which class trainer might ye be looking for?
Please continue.

We already have a winner for our contest, but Jang is willing to purchase any Tastyfish that you have fished up!

There is always next Sunday for you to show your Angling skill!
%s will be armed in 5 seconds!
Between the orange and the purple passageways near the doors to Maraudon, you will find a third path.$B$BThe scepter you hold in your hands is the key.
Gubber, I don't have a fishing pole.

$n, pay very close attention to what I do and follow my instructions precisely. To not heed my words is to sign your own death warrant, as Taskmaster Fizzule is VERY well versed in the ways of the warrior and the assassin.
Now let's heat up these flakes...
Very well, $n. I will use the Nightmare object to conjure forth Eranikus.
Tired of all those pansy spellcaster drinks? Try something stronger at the Pig and Whistle!

Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.
Feeling hot? Get something to cool you off down at the Pig and Whistle!
%s raises his hand and then lowers it.

Hail, $c!  Our supply level is high, and we are ready to launch a ground assault through the Field of Strife.  Perhaps if your renown was greater, I would trust you to deliver the assault orders.$B$BSo get out there and fight the Alliance!  Show me you're a trusted and capable member of the Horde!
There's only one person I know of who is more learned in the art of tailoring than myself. Last I heard he could be found in Theramore Isle. He is the person you should seek.
The fabric of which our world is woven is most delicate. It merely takes some knowledge and the application of said knowledge to tear the fabric. It is thusly that rifts are born.
